Dave was 40. Like most other 40-year-olds, Dave hated his job. It was because Dave hated his job, that he hated the office party that Chad, the new young hotshot who had been promoted past him in just 4 months, was hosting at his newly-purchased mansion. Needless to say, Dave did not like Chad.

Dave stood by the cooler, not wanting to be at the party but still frugal enough to come and enjoy the free food. Grudgingly, Dave admitted that the food was indeed very good. This made Dave hate Chad even more so. Dave was the type of man who would spent his time in the break room by the water cooler, and so today especially under the blazing-hot sun, he found himself near the patio roof, standing by the drinks cooler watching the young secretaries in the pool swimming with Chad.

Dave paused, putting down his cup to scratch away at his chin. Yesterday he had shaven himself clean, but today yet again, he had a full beard. He gave his beard one last scratch before picking up his drink again, leaning on the gigantic punch bowl of the cucumber melon water that sat on the table.

"Chaaaaaaad! My man!" It was Brad, Chad's equally annoying counterpart. "Where did you get all this liquor?" Dave could see that a puzzled expression had registered on Chad's face. As hard to believe as it was, Brad was an even bigger idiot than Chad, and should have known that there would be no alcohol at a daytime work party, apart from some watered down beers. It was then that Dave turned around, and saw that the punchbowl was now full of wine.

Water into wine, Dave thought to himself. Where have I seen this before...? Whatever had happened, Dave decided that Brad had something to do with it, and didn't trust the punchbowl, going so far as to leave the patio and walk towards the poolside.

It was then that Dave tripped over one of the gigantic dumbbells that Chad had been using earlier to show off to the girls. Dave flew into the pool, his cup tracing a majestic arc through the air before plopping down in the water nearby. Dave had hit the water like a rock, despite not having fallen from too high up. Blinded by the chlorine, Dave grabbed for the nearest edge and hoisted himself up, only to hear gasps and screams.

Dave opened his eyes. He found himself standing on the water. What was happening here?

Dave spoke aloud in amazement. "Jesus H. Christ..."

A voice suddenly replied to him, from within his head. "You called?"
